title: Preprocessors: Canny in core, and looking at your map

questions.q: What are the Canny node's thresholds compared with?
options: The unscaled gradient magnitude, which is about 2.59 times the contrast of a straight edge
questions.answer: The unscaled gradient magnitude, which is about 2.59 times the contrast of a straight edge
questions.why: kornia does not scale its Sobel. A unit step gives about 2.59 after the default blur, and the thresholds are compared with that.

questions.q: At the default high_threshold of 0.8, what is the smallest contrast of a straight edge that can start a line?
questions.why: 0.8 / 2.59 is 0.309. In the lab, contrast 0.3 fails and 0.31 passes.

questions.q: Your map is nearly black, but the picture has clear shapes. What do you try first?
questions.why: The edges are below the high threshold. A black map gives the ControlNet nothing to follow, and strength multiplies nothing.

questions.q: Your hint is 1920 x 1080 and your render is 512 x 512. What happens?
options: The hint is squashed to fit
The hint's centre 1080 x 1080 is used, and the sides are thrown away
questions.answer: The hint's centre 1080 x 1080 is used, and the sides are thrown away
questions.why: get_control calls common_upscale with crop center. The lab shows only 0.56 of the hint is kept.

questions.q: At thresholds 0.05 and 0.1 in the lab's noisy scene, what is wrong with the map?
options: About a third of the background is speckled with false edges
questions.answer: About a third of the background is speckled with false edges
questions.why: Noise beats thresholds that low. A third of the far background is marked, and the ControlNet would follow it.
